name: The Torch of Retribution
summary: Kalaran Windblade has finished the torch and asks you to claim it.

sections.title: Binding the Flame
sections.body: Kalaran Windblade says the torch must be bound to its owner. He asks you to take it up yourself.

sections.title: The Torch in Hand
sections.body: Hatred and anger surge through you when you lift the torch in both hands.

faq.q: Who tells you to take the torch?
faq.answer: Kalaran Windblade tells you to take the torch so it can be bound to its owner.

faq.q: Why must you pick up the torch?
faq.answer: Kalaran says the torch must be bound to its owner, so he asks you to take it up.

faq.q: Where does this step fit into the chain?
faq.answer: This follows the earlier Torch of Retribution step, when you waited as Kalaran combined the pieces and enchanted them.
